g.title: 25d34613034a41de9a3a936dfb32387d
g.text: • No static AWS keys: GitHub OIDC + EC2 instance roles
• IMDSv2 · encrypted EBS · KMS for S3 state & ECR
• SG least-privilege: :22 admin IP → controller only
• Jenkins :8080 only from admin IP + GitHub hooks
• Break-glass access via SSM Session Manager

g.title: f68538d2ce684df8b8cfd3f11cd7cc97
g.text: • 1 NAT GW (AZ-1a): saves cost, but cross-AZ traffic
and single point of failure for AZ-1b egress
• Prod: 1 NAT per AZ + VPC endpoints (ECR, S3, STS)
